title: SM-16.03 - Who is not impacted by the EUSurvey transition
intent: This article answers: SM-16.03 - Who is not impacted by the EUSurvey transition
short_answer: Staff of EU Institutions, Bodies, Offices and Agencies are not affected. Users responding to surveys, participating in open public consultations, or accessing published results are also not affected. External users working on behalf of an EU institution may continue to manage surveys created by an EU institutional user if appropriate permissions are granted.
important_conditions: Survey creation rights remain with EU institutional users.
The change concerns survey administration and management, not participation in surveys.
